changes: 16 setlists of up to 16 songs from any book, played one after the other without a gap.
SETLSTS in the arranger menu: start, reorder, copy, paste and name setlists; CUE + YES in BOOKS adds a song.
While a setlist plays, the main screen shows it, and CUE + YES lets you pick the next song.
A project comes back into its setlist after LOAD, RELOAD or a power cycle.
The arranger menu's CHANGE reads BOOKS; its title shows the book and the arrangement.
128 arrangements per project: 16 books of 8, book 1 being the Octatrack's own 8.
In ARR > CHANGE, stopped, LEFT and RIGHT step between books; BOOK 2 and so on shows at the top right.
Every arrangement is an ordinary arrangement file, arr01 to arr128, saved and reloaded with the project.
A project reopens on the book, arrangement and arranger mode it was left on.
